# Roots, and What Came Later

<!-- STEP id="what-the-roots-had" -->
## Real Roots

The answer is: in part. The old assemblies and the Saṁgha show consultation and discussion, and the Saṁgha shows voting. These are real roots of democracy.

<!-- STEP id="every-adult" -->
## Every Adult Votes

Those gatherings were for some people, not for all. Today every citizen aged 18 or above has the right to vote.

<!-- STEP id="rights-and-courts" -->
## Written Rights, Courts to Protect Them

A written Constitution now gives Fundamental Rights to all citizens, and courts protect them.

**India's democracy did not appear suddenly: it grew through a long historical process.**
